name: yf_fast_info
description:
Quick price snapshot for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance fast_info), lighter than yf_stock_info.
Returns: {symbol, fast_info: {market_cap, last_price, fifty_day_average, two_hundred_day_average, year_high, year_low, shares_outstanding}}; a field is null when Yahoo lacks it.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Full profile: yf_stock_info; side-by-side for several tickers: yf_compare_stocks. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}
